licenseIdsMeaning: References identify retained license documents applicable to the described components or their stated source projects. Multiple references are not alternative dual-license choices and are not a complete SPDX expression. A repository declaration does not relicense unrelated bundled data.

statusDefinitions.confirmed: The specific content or source match described in summary was verified; this is not a whole-chain rights guarantee.
statusDefinitions.declared: An upstream license declaration supports the classification, without a complete reproducible provenance proof.
statusDefinitions.pending: The listed provenance, rights, or distribution obligations remain unresolved even where a license declaration exists.

pathScopes.model: Paths are relative to the original downloaded model root. A terminal /** matches every descendant; all other paths are exact.
pathScopes.shared: Paths are relative to the application's shared resource root.

licenses.text:
## Date:  August 8, 1998
##
## The Carnegie Mellon Pronouncing Dictionary [cmudict.0.6] is Copyright 1998
## by Carnegie Mellon University. Use of this dictionary, for any research or
## commercial purpose, is completely unrestricted.  If you make use of or
## redistribute this material, we would appreciate acknowlegement of its
## origin.
##
## cmudict.0.6 is the fifth release of cmudict, first released as cmudict.0.1
## in September of 1993.  There was no generally available public release
## of version 0.5.
##
## See the README in this directory before you use this dictionary.
##
## Thanks to Bill Huggins at BBN; Bill Fisher at NIST; Alex Hauptman,
## Alex Rudnicky, Jack Mostow, Roni Rosenfeld, Richard Stern,
## Matthew Siegler, Kevin Lenzo, Maxine Eskenazi, Mosur Ravishankar,
## Eric Thayer, Kristie Seymore, and Raj Reddy at CMU; Lin Chase at
## LIMSI; Doug Paul at MIT Lincoln Labs; Ben Serridge at MIT SLS; Murray
## Spiegel at Bellcore; Tony Robinson at Cambridge UK; David Bowness of
## CAE Electronics Ltd. and CRIM; Stephen Hocking; Jerry Quinn at BNR
## Canada, and Marshal Midden for bringing to our attention problems and
## inadequacies with the first releases. Most special thanks to Bob Weide
## for all his work on prior versions of the dictionary.
##
## We welcome input from users and will continue to acknowledge such input
## in subsequent releases. If I failed to acknowledge your input in this
## release, please remind me and I will update these comments. If I failed to
## fix things that you brought to my attention, please remind me and have
## patience. If I actually fixed things that you brought to my attention and
## you appreciate it, I wouldn't mind a pat on the back.
##
## This version differs from previous releases of cmudict most significantly
## in the addition of new words from the common ARPA tasks for 1996 and 1997.
##
## There are undoubtedly still errors and inconsistencies in this dictionary
## so keep your eyes open for problems and mail them to me.
##
## We hope this dictionary is an improvement over cmudict.0.4.
##
## email: cmudict@cs.cmu.edu
## web:   http://www.speech.cs.cmu.edu/cgi-bin/cmudict
## ftp:   ftp://ftp.cs.cmu.edu/project/speech/dict/
##
## Thank you for your continued interest in the CMU Pronouncing
## Dictionary.  Further addictions and improvements are planned
## for forthcoming releases.
##

models.attribution: X-ASR by Gilgamesh-J / GilgameshWind; trained using icefall and deployed with sherpa-onnx. The locked HF model card expressly covers model artifacts and declares Apache-2.0. The separately discovered GitHub license commit is not the locked HF revision. No root LICENSE or NOTICE was listed in the inspected HF tree; this is not proof that every historical distribution lacks NOTICE. Retain applicable upstream notices when found.

groups.summary: Apache-2.0 is explicitly declared for X-ASR model artifacts. The sherpa export script describes icefall streaming ONNX export and INT8 quantization; installed file hashes match the catalog, but the 2026-06-05 archive-to-checkpoint/build identity is not established.
pendingReasons: Exact checkpoint and source commits used to build the 2026-06-05 INT8 archive remain unverified; the export script downloads moving main URLs. Training-data rights are not fully audited.

groups.summary: X-ASR token resource, not the SentencePiece or sherpa software. The punctuation export block downloads X-ASR-zh-en/zipformer/data/lang_5000_with_punctuation/tokens.txt. Catalog content SHA256: b818a60878b9aae978cbb8ad594acbd403d76d1af2e31ef4197c84e2dbdba27c.
pendingReasons: The historical source revision for the token file in the 2026-06-05 archive is not pinned by the export script.

groups.summary: X-ASR BPE resource. The export script renames X-ASR-zh-en/zipformer/data/lang_5000_with_punctuation/bpe_punc.model to bpe.model. Its license classification comes from X-ASR, not from the software that reads the SentencePiece format.
pendingReasons: The historical BPE source commit and exact archive build provenance remain unverified.

groups.summary: Modified by Pisper: extracted the ordered SentencePiece pieces and scores as UTF-8 piece<TAB>score<LF> lines. This local text derivative retains the source resource license classification; it is not newly licensed as Pisper-owned model data. Original and derived hashes and generator are bound by xasr-bpe-extraction below.
pendingReasons: The source BPE historical provenance remains pending as described in xasr-bpe. A text extraction does not resolve upstream rights.

modifications.summary: Local BPE text extraction, not retraining. The generator identity records the inspected repository implementation, not a claim about a historical upstream build date.

generator.method: sentencePieceModelToVocab decodes ordered protobuf ModelProto.pieces and emits each piece, a tab, its finite score, and a newline without changing the BPE model.

models.attribution: MeloTTS by MyShell.ai; sherpa-onnx ONNX conversion. The retained software license is Copyright (c) 2024 MyShell.ai, MIT. The neural-weight repository separately declares MIT; dictionary and FST resources have separate declarations and pending provenance. Pisper selects the original single female voice via public sid 0 and uses the same original FP32 ONNX, tokens, mixed-language lexicon, dictionary and normalization files on Desktop, Android and iOS. No retraining, quantization, graph/metadata patch or voice-subset derivative is made. The unused new_heteronym.fst and 133-byte model.int8.onnx Git LFS pointer in the transport archive are drained but not installed; retained model files are unchanged. These choices do not imply upstream/speaker endorsement, redistribution approval or completed native-platform acceptance.

groups.summary: The myshell-ai/MeloTTS-Chinese model card at af5d207a364ea4208c6f589c89f57f88414bdd16 declares license: mit for the model repository; this is separate evidence from the MeloTTS software MIT license. The sherpa conversion package carries the exact MyShell.ai MIT text, and original ONNX metadata declares MIT license, melo-vits version 2, Chinese + English, n_speakers=1 and speaker_id=1. The conversion README explicitly describes a single female Chinese+English speaker. sherpa maps public sid 0 to the internal metadata speaker_id; Pisper does not change the graph, metadata or speaker embedding.
